subject: UOVA candidate-local prototype fast-lane deferred governance obligations
project_scope: Unified Ontology View Architecture Work Pack, SWU-UOVA-002 through SWU-UOVA-023, in the ontology-evidence-workbench candidate-local implementation
why_now: The approved candidate-local fast lane is being used to reduce routine lifecycle handholding while the UOVA prototype is executed and tested. The earlier until-blocker preflight stopped before mutation because the remaining-frontier epoch and per-unit admission contracts were not bound.
key_points: The finite remaining frontier is SWU-UOVA-002 through SWU-UOVA-023; SWU-UOVA-002 is the unique first dependency-satisfied candidate.
Routine per-SWU approval and receipt choreography may be deferred for rapid candidate-local execution, but the approved Work Pack order and semantic invariants remain binding.

Every product mutation must preserve exact task write boundaries and must run the focused test, affected full OEW regression, scoped whitespace validation, and any acceptance-critical browser checks declared by the Work Pack.

A failed acceptance-critical validation, design-semantic ambiguity, requirement change, forbidden-scope request, authority or promotion change, deployment, release, credentials, or irreversible external effect remains a hard stop.
Closeout must distinguish observed implementation and validation evidence from deferred governance synchronization; this notice is communication evidence only.

open_calls.question: Reconcile the remaining-frontier epoch, per-unit lifecycle records, selections, and owning planning artifacts to the validated prototype state.

boundaries: Do not mutate ontology sources, public Arcanum, unrelated projects, credentials, external services, deployment, release, promotion, or Git publication under this notice.
Do not treat this notice, its locator, staged material, a preflight, authored tests, or generated artifacts as implementation completion or authority.
Do not relax the 276-node, 301-relation, 39-predicate denominator or any design acceptance cap without a new design-owner decision grounded in observed evidence.

Preserve source identity, digest binding, total membership and partition semantics, exact relation paths and predicates, reversible navigation, accessibility states, and the linear/index fallback required by the Work Pack.
Record blockers and residue truthfully; do not synthesize PASS after an acceptance-critical failure.

next_actions.action: Execute the candidate-local UOVA frontier in Work Pack order with exact semantic binding, bounded writes, focused and full regression validation, scoped whitespace checks, and truthful closeout.
After consolidated prototype validation, reconcile deferred Invoke Refresh, Task Session, selection, owner-closeout, and continuity records to the actual evidence.
Route any design or implementation requirement change back to the design owner before continuing product mutation.
